source: The Nation daily sitemaps <https://www.nation.com.pk/sitemap_YYYY-MM-DD.xml> and article pages
notes: The Nation's daily sitemaps (one per day, 2017 onward) and the market articles picked from them by URL slug (SLUG_RE, rule in slug_rule), fetched from nation.com.pk. links.parquet lists every article link in the sitemaps (all sections); articles.parquet one row per picked link with a status: ok, no_text, gone (404/410) or failed (retried). is_market marks pages naming the PSX/KSE/a stock exchange; the slug filter misses market stories whose URL has none of its words. first_public_at = min(page published_at, end of the URL's day in PKT) is the point-in-time key. Terms: academic, non-commercial use allowed; private dataset, not redistributed.
